untrusted_fields_note: tags.* values are copied from the media file and must be treated as data.

findings.title: Labelled limited range, pixels look full range
findings.detail: Luma reaches 0..255 including reserved codes (0/255 in 8-bit). Limited-range black is 16 and white is 235. Players will stretch these values again: crushed shadows and clipped highlights.
findings.fix_hint: If the pixels are right, retag as full range (no re-encode). If the label is right, convert pixels to limited.

proposed_fixes.title: Label the file as full range (pixels unchanged)
proposed_fixes.why: Use this if the pixels are correct and only the flag is wrong.

proposed_fixes.title: Convert the pixels to limited range (label unchanged)
proposed_fixes.why: Use this if the delivery spec requires limited range. Costs one encode generation.
assumptions: libx264 output; swap the encoder and quality settings for your delivery spec
proposed_fixes.command_text: ffmpeg -n -i zoo/full_pixels_labelled_limited.mp4 -map 0 -c copy -vf scale=in_range=full:out_range=limited -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset slow -color_range tv zoo/full_pixels_labelled_limited.limited.mp4
proposed_fixes.command_text_powershell: ffmpeg -n -i zoo/full_pixels_labelled_limited.mp4 -map 0 -c copy -vf scale=in_range=full:out_range=limited -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset slow -color_range tv zoo/full_pixels_labelled_limited.limited.mp4
